data.name: Send SMS message to a mobile number
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends a transactional SMS to a mobile number through Brevo's SMS service. Use it to deliver an individual outbound message.
Use for: send one SMS, deliver alerts, send transactional messages
Not supported: campaign scheduling, delivery subscriptions, inbound SMS

data.name: SMS via Twilio
data.description:
Using Twilio test credentials to run this POST request to send an SMS.
Read more about the Twilio Messaging API.
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends an SMS message through Twilio Messaging. Use it to deliver a message from a Twilio account to a recipient.
Use for: send an SMS, send test messages, deliver notifications
Not supported: campaign management, delivery subscriptions, inbound message handling

data.name: Send your SMS campaign immediately
data.evaluateGuide:
Immediately sends an existing SMS campaign through Brevo. Use it when a prepared campaign is ready for delivery.
Use for: launch an SMS campaign, send a scheduled campaign now, trigger campaign delivery
Not supported: campaign creation, individual transactional SMS, test sends

data.name: Send SMS - request identified by customerID
data.description: Send an outbound SMS to one or many recipients.
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends an outbound SMS to one or more recipients through Vodafone's OneAPI sandbox. Use it to test customer-identified messaging flows.
Use for: send outbound SMS, message multiple recipients, test SMS delivery
Not supported: inbound subscriptions, campaign management, delivery reports

data.name: Send sms message(s)
data.description:
Send sms message(s)
Send one or more SMS messages
You can post up to 1000 messages with each API call. You can send to a mix of contacts and contact lists, as long as the total number of recipients is up to 1000. 
The response contains status and details for each recipient.
Refer to Application Status Codes for the possible response message status strings.
Response Codes

200 SUCCESS
400 BAD_REQUEST
401 UNAUTHORIZED
403 FORBIDDEN
404 NOT_FOUND
405 METHODNOTFOUND
429 TOOMANYREQUESTS
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends one or more SMS messages through ClickSend, supporting up to 1,000 recipients per endpoint call. The response reports status details for each recipient.
Use for: bulk SMS, send contact-list messages, deliver notifications
Not supported: campaign scheduling, inbound SMS, delivery subscription management

data.name: Send SMS
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends an SMS message through Twilio Messaging. Use it to deliver an outbound message from a Twilio account.
Use for: send an SMS, deliver alerts, test messaging
Not supported: campaign management, inbound message handling, delivery subscriptions

data.name: sms/send test numbers
data.description: Sends SMS messages to one or more test numbers for validation purposes. Accepts a request body containing recipient test numbers and message content. Returns the send status and details for each test message submitted.
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends SMS messages to one or more test numbers through ClickSend for validation. The response provides submission status and details for each test message.
Use for: validate SMS delivery, send test messages, check recipient handling
Not supported: production campaign management, inbound SMS, delivery subscriptions

data.name: Subscribe to SMS delivery - request identified by customerID
data.description: Subscribe to receive SMS delivery notifications for inbound SMS.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a subscription for SMS delivery notifications through Vodafone's OneAPI sandbox. Use it to receive notifications about inbound SMS activity.
Use for: subscribe to SMS notifications, monitor inbound SMS, test delivery subscriptions
Not supported: sending outbound SMS, campaign management, message retrieval

data.name: Send a test SMS campaign
data.evaluateGuide:

Use for: test an SMS campaign, preview campaign delivery, validate recipients
Not supported: immediate campaign launch, campaign creation, transactional SMS
